page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at top right; main text column in the centre (heading, paragraph, centred lines, catchword-like signature "CAPVT" at lower right of text); left margin holds a narrow strip of notes from the adjoining page (fragmentary, cut off by the binding, not transcribed as readable text); no other blocks.

p.i: Scholæ hoc loco Numerum in Digitum, Articulum & Compositum diuidunt, ad distinguendam opinor naturalem numerorum consequutionem, in qua primum Simplices notæ nouem spectantur, quas Denarius internodij instar excipit, Coniunctis subsequentibus. Verum cum hæc legitima numeri diuisio non sit, alia deducetur, è Diuisione, postrema simplicis numerationis parte, cuius fructus uberrimus erit. Interim si priores duæ Metaphoricæ appellationes (quæ huic loco ansam dederunt, quo Arithmeticum pauciores habere digitos, plures autem articulos homine, dicitant) displiceant, rectius forte numeros Simplices, Decades atq; Coniunctos appellaueris.

page.notes: The left margin strip contains cut-off fragments of notes from the facing page, too damaged to transcribe reliably. The catchword-like word "CAPVT" is set at the lower right of the text block and is treated as a closing word. The page number "13" is printed at top right as "ɩʒ" and is read as 13.
